caption: Teatro Massimo, Palermo
composition: Neoclassical opera house facade with staircase, Corinthian colonnade and quadriga · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The tourist faces the Teatro Massimo's grand neoclassical front, its Corinthian colonnade rising center-frame above the wide ceremonial staircase. Atop the pediment stands the bronze quadriga, a winged figure driving four horses against the blue sky. Arched side wings extend left and right, with vintage lampposts along the empty piazza. The midday sun at 12:00 is strong and shadow-short under scattered cloud.
